title: Billionaire Peter Thiel buys 1% stake in Argentine Vaca Muerta oil firm, filing shows
title_zh: 文件显示，亿万富翁 Peter Thiel 购买了阿根廷 Vaca Muerta 石油公司 1% 的股份
summary: BUENOS AIRES, Aug 15 (Reuters) - Palantir chair and co-founder Peter Thiel has bought a 1% stake in Argentina's Vista, one of the largest oil companies operating in the country's Vaca Muerta shale
summary_zh: 路透布宜诺斯艾利斯 8 月 15 日 - Palantir 董事长兼联合创始人 Peter Thiel 购买了阿根廷 Vista 公司 1% 的股份，该公司是在该国 Vaca Muerta 页岩运营的最大石油公司之一

title: Bond Traders Are Agonizing Over $70 Billion of Shadow Credit Backstops For AI Companies
title_zh: 债券交易员正在为人工智能公司超过 700 亿美元的影子信贷支持而苦恼
summary: Even before Nvidia Corp.’s splashy $500 billion financing partnership this week, investors were starting to fret over the roughly $70 billion in phantom liabilities that don’t appear on major AI companies’ balance sheets, but could materialize at the worst possible time.
summary_zh: 甚至在英伟达公司本周达成引人注目的 5000 亿美元融资合作之前，投资者就开始担心大约 700 亿美元的幽灵负债，这些负债并未出现在主要人工智能公司的资产负债表上，但可能会在最糟糕的时候出现。

title: AI compute is 'critical infrastructure' like railroads & steel: Hut 8 CEO
title_zh: Hut 8 首席执行官：人工智能计算是像铁路和钢铁一样的“关键基础设施”
summary: Hut 8 (HUT) CEO Asher Genoot compares AI compute buildout to historical infrastructure booms like railroads and steel, projecting $1.75 billion in annual net operating income as new data centers come online.
summary_zh: Hut 8 (HUT) 首席执行官 Asher Genoot 将人工智能计算建设与铁路和钢铁等历史基础设施繁荣进行了比较，预计随着新数据中心的上线，年净运营收入将达到 17.5 亿美元。

title: Reddit stock is surging thanks to the S&P 500, but it hasn't solved its big dilemma
title_zh: 得益于标准普尔 500 指数，Reddit 股价飙升，但仍未解决其大困境
summary: Down double digits so far this year, Reddit joining the S&P 500 next week is welcome news for investors who believe in the forum's singular appeal.
summary_zh: 今年迄今为止，Reddit 的股价已下跌两位数，下周加入标准普尔 500 指数，对于相信该论坛独特吸引力的投资者来说是个好消息。

title: Alibaba AI Models Hit 3 Billion Downloads, Passing Meta, Google
title_zh: 阿里巴巴AI模型下载量突破30亿次，超越Meta、Google
summary: Alibaba Group Holding’s open-weight models have accumulated more than 3 billion global downloads in the past six months, eclipsing Meta Platforms Inc., Alphabet Inc. and domestic peers to become the world’s No. 1 artificial-intelligence model.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴集团控股的开放权重模型在过去六个月内累计全球下载量超过30亿次，超越Meta Platforms Inc.、Alphabet Inc.和国内同行，成为全球第一的人工智能模型。
